name: Reijou Sera
source:
Sera awakens in a mansion and is told by the owner that her relative owed a huge debt. Now Sera has to serve at the mansion to pay the debt. And there's a strict punishment for every small mistake there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
塞拉在一座宅邸中醒来。主人告诉她，她的一位亲属欠下了巨额债务。如今，塞拉必须在宅邸里服侍主人，偿还这笔债务。而在那里，每一个小小的失误，都会招来严厉的惩罚。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
